top_signals.title: Dutch Police Arrest ‘Reformed’ Hacker in Shiny Hunters Investigation
top_signals.summary: Authorities in the Netherlands have arrested a 23-year-old convicted cybercriminal on suspicion of aiding in data thefts and extortions by the prolific hacker group ShinyHunters. In the days immediately following the suspect's arrest, remaining ShinyHunters members dramatically escalated their attacks, stealing highly sensitive data from the FBI and extorting the Russian ransomware group Cl0p.

top_signals.title: Brothers in Arms, Partners in Healing: A Story about a Breakthrough in Treating Post-Traumatic Stress
top_signals.summary:
After losing fellow marines in Iraq, Jeff Lindquist struggled with post-traumatic stress that was steadily destroying his life. Years later, an innovative technology helped him reclaim it. This is the story of Jeff and Erik Won, two veterans who served together, and how efforts to help Jeff recover was the first step on a mission to help others suffering from post-traumatic stress do the same, using Magnetic e-Resonance Therapy (MeRT) and synchronized transcranial magnetic stimulation.Disclaimer: This discussion is for informational and educational purposes only and does not establish a doctor-patient relationship.
